Without exception, the young masters and mistress were just like the vicious antagonists in storybooks, yet they were adored wherever they went. The eldest young master was a smiling fox who was always scheming behind people’s backs, but everyone admired the gentle and kind image he presented. The second young master had a temper worse than anyone’s, yet people praised him for his “refreshing honesty.” The young mistress was cold and peculiar, displeased with everyone she met. Even so, people pitied her for her extraordinary talent and frail constitution. Even the cultivator they constantly targeted—a man who appeared even poorer than Mei Man—was gifted with remarkable talent and a dazzling future. As for her, she was merely a malicious little lackey trailing behind them, looked down upon by everyone. Mei Man was indignant. But she couldn’t bear to give up the generous pay, and she also wanted to graduate from the academy safely. Thus, she could only vent her resentment by secretly causing trouble. Besides, she had plenty of powerful backers. If she schemed against the eldest young master, she could always turn to the second young master for protection. If she betrayed the second young master, she could run to the young mistress and cry for sympathy. And if she harmed the young mistress, the eldest young master could shield her from the consequences. As long as she remained a fence-sitter, there would always be someone willing to protect her. But as time passed, she gradually began to realize that something was wrong. Why did the young masters and mistress continue keeping her at their side even though they knew perfectly well that she was a shameless fence-sitter? Why did the supposedly brilliant genius drink the tea she handed him, even though he clearly knew she had laced it with poison? Why did the young master and mistress, who had been close since childhood, gradually grow distant after they came of age—so distant that an undercurrent of hostility even began to form between them? ... In the original story, she and the villain’s domineering CEO father are bound by a contractual marriage. After failing to seduce him, she takes the child on a parenting reality show. Not only does she become a shameless foil to the male lead and his actress mother, but she also attempts to get rid of the villain. Unfortunately, her schemes are exposed. In the end, her reputation is ruined, and she earns herself a permanent stay behind bars. At the thought of this, Xu Wanci silently unlocks her phone, checks the balance in her bank account, and decides to lie flat on the spot. She has money, free time, a husband, and a child—at last, this absurdly wonderful life of luxury is hers! As for love and romance? Xu Wanci lets out a dismissive laugh. A single job is enough to make anyone behave themselves. But can someone please explain why the man who was supposed to keep to his side of the line is in her bed? And dressed like that??? Absolutely indecent! *(Covers her eyes—while peeking through her fingers.)* — After the parenting show becomes a massive hit, countless netizens begin speculating about Xu Wanci’s husband—the father of her child. Some even spread rumors that she is being kept by someone, a mistress too shameful to be seen in public. Then, the powerful head of a major Beijing conglomerate—someone who has never posted on social media—can’t wait to upload two marriage certificates. “It’s me.” *(Proud golden-retriever-husband.jpg)* The entire internet is stunned!
